LinuxUdevEnumerateSafeHandle.cs: Reviewed pointer-zero invalidity and enumerate unref; list-entry pointers remain borrowed until enumeration owner disposal.

LinuxUdevSafeHandle.cs: Reviewed udev context unref on pointer handle; libc int descriptor rules are deliberately separate.
